subject: Acme Cloud - Insurance naming, COI timing, and MSA endorsement request
messages:
From: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@acme-corp.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@acme-corp.com, samir.naik@tidesinsurance.com
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Order form and insurance checklist (ACME-8921)

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the order form. Please find attached the signed Order Form (v2) and a short insurance checklist from our procurement team. Two items for us to confirm before we can proceed to countersign:

- Additional insured wording: Acme requires the endorsement to name "Acme, its affiliates and customers" as Additional Insureds on Redwood's policy (we can provide standard language).
- Certificate of Insurance (COI): we need a COI showing coverage limits and an endorsement or written confirmation for Waiver of Subrogation and Primary & Non-contributory language.

Target date for obtaining COI & endorsement is 2027-03-28 to keep our rollout timeline. If you need to coordinate directly with our broker, Samir Naik at Tides Insurance (samir.naik@tidesinsurance.com) is copied.

Also attaching the procurement checklist: ACME_Insurance_Checklist.pdf (see attachment). Please confirm who on your side will coordinate with the carrier and whether Redwood can provide a sample endorsement quickly.

Best,
Olivia Grant
Sr. Contracts Manager
Acme Cloud

Attachments: ACME_OrderForm_v2_redline.docx, ACME_Insurance_Checklist.pdf

From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@acme-corp.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form and insurance checklist (ACME-8921)

Hi Olivia — thanks for sending this over and outlining the timeline. Looping in Aditya (account lead) and Laura from legal to help with the endorsement language. Quick responses below:

- Additional insured: Redwood's preference is to limit Additional Insureds to the contracting party and its affiliates rather than downstream customers. Could you confirm whether Acme requires that broad inclusion for all customers or only when Acme is reselling into a named customer under a separate SOW? If it's the latter, we can agree to a named-customer carve-in.
- Primary & Non-contributory + Waiver: We can provide an endorsement with primary/non-contributory and a waiver of subrogation; need broker to confirm whether their carrier will issue.
- COI timing: Targeting 3/28 is reasonable if Samir can prioritize. Our broker will need the exact endorsement wording and the entity list to add to the endorsement.

I've attached Redwood_MSA_insurance_guidance_v1.pdf for your review — it maps our standard limits and the endorsement templates we typically provide. If Acme can confirm the final wording (or accept our template with the "customers" clause limited to named customers on SOWs), we will ask our carrier to issue the COI + endorsement.

Next steps:
- Olivia: confirm whether Acme requires a universal "customers" inclusion or only for named customers.
- Samir: if you can confirm carrier & expected turnaround, please advise.
- Laura/Karthik: will review once Olivia confirms.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Contracts Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_insurance_guidance_v1.pdf

From: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@acme-corp.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@acme-corp.com, Samir Naik <samir.naik@tidesinsurance.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form and insurance checklist (ACME-8921)

Thanks Neha — good to know. A bit of background: Acme often resells via marketplace integrations and, for commercial/legal reasons, we need the broader language to cover customers in most cases. We are open to limited carve-outs when a reseller arrangement is explicitly scoped (i.e., named customer on SOW), but our baseline ask is: "Acme, its affiliates and customers."

Samir from our broker confirms the carrier can issue an endorsement with that language, but they need Redwood's sample endorsement text and the entity list to be appended to the endorsement. Samir flagged that typical turnaround is 5-7 business days after they have the exact wording.

Please find attached an example of our accepted wording: Acme_accepted_wording.docx. If Redwood can accept either: (a) universal customers inclusion; or (b) customers only when explicitly named in SOW but with a separate SOW-level mechanism to add named customers, let us know which option is acceptable to you.

Olivia

Attachments: Acme_accepted_wording.docx

From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Grant <olivia.grant@acme-corp.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order form and insurance checklist (ACME-8921)

Olivia — thanks for the clarification and for looping Samir in. After internal review, here are Redwood's proposed positions and the path to sign-off so we can meet your 3/28 rollout target: 

1) Additional Insured wording (compromise):
   - Redwood agrees to the following endorsement language for deals where Acme is reselling to a named customer listed on a SOW: "Acme, its affiliates and customers".
   - For general marketplace/listing agreements without a named downstream customer, Redwood will limit Additional Insureds to "Acme and its affiliates".
   - Rationale: this gives Acme coverage for reseller deals while protecting Redwood from open-ended blanket customer additions.

2) Primary & Non-contributory; Waiver of Subrogation:
   - Redwood can provide an endorsement confirming Primary & Non-contributory and Waiver of Subrogation where allowed by the carrier. This will be included in the endorsement request to the insurer.

3) Evidence & timing:
   - Redwood will request COI + endorsement from our carrier as soon as Acme confirms the final endorsement wording and provides the entity list. Samir indicated 5-7 business days after wording is provided; we will flag this as high priority.
   - To meet 3/28, we need confirmation by end of day 3/23 from Acme (final wording + entity list) and Samir's acknowledgement of the expedited timeline.

4) Document updates:
   - Contracts (Karthik) will prepare a redline to the Order Form/MA to reflect the naming compromise and a short SOW clause that permits adding named customers on a per-SOW basis. Karthik — can you prepare the redline and share a DocuSign-ready copy by 3/24?

5) Attachments & next steps:
   - I've attached a COI_submission_template.pdf that our broker prefers as a checklist to populate.
   - Olivia/Samir: please confirm acceptance of the compromise language OR propose alternate wording by EOD 3/23. If accepted, we'll trigger the endorsement request immediately.

Appreciate the cooperative tone — looping in Karthik & Laura for the redline and legal sign-off.

Best regards,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Contracts Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: COI_submission_template.pdf
